native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Powershell Empire Stager
native_rule.s1ql:
(
  event.category = 'Process'
  AND src.process.commandLine ILIKE 'powershell'
)
AND
(
  src.process.commandLine ILIKE 'SQBmACgAJAB'
  OR
  (
    src.process.commandLine ILIKE '-ScriptBlock'
    AND src.process.commandLine ILIKE 'http'
  )
)
AND NOT
(
  src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Agent'
  OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Kaseya'
  OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'MSP'
  OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Choco'
)
AND NOT
(
  src.process.parent.image.path contains:anycase 'Agent'
  OR src.process.parent.image.path contains:anycase 'Kaseya'
  OR src.process.parent.image.path contains:anycase 'MSP'
)
